_comment: Agenda de eventos da comunidade. A classificacao entre proximos e edicoes anteriores e feita no navegador comparando 'data' (e 'dataFim', quando o evento dura mais de um dia) com a data de hoje — nao mexa em HTML para atualizar: acrescente ou edite itens aqui e atualize 'atualizadoEm'. Formato: AAAA-MM-DD. 'links.transmissao' vira o botao 'Assistir ao vivo'. 'dataFim' e opcional: sem ele, o evento e de um dia so.
intro: Where Brazil's database community gets together. Dates, venues, and registration confirmed on the official sites.

itens.desc: Record attempt for the longest programming class ever, with 80 continuous hours of Intro to SQL and Database Administration. Led by professor Matheus Boesing, in a hybrid format with live streaming.
Brazil's largest PostgreSQL conference, with three days of technical tracks, tutorials, and community.
The annual conference of the Brazil MySQL Community, with a technical track dedicated to MySQL, HeatWave, and high availability.
The annual meeting of the Brazil Oracle Technology Users Group, part of the LAOUC circuit spanning eight Latin American countries.
itens.local: USCS — Universidade Municipal de São Caetano do Sul

itens.desc: The largest data and artificial intelligence event in Espírito Santo, with talks by Power Tuning consultants all day long.

realizador.texto: Espírito Santo-based consultancy and Microsoft Solutions Partner (Data & AI + Azure), with 12 years and 1,400+ companies served across SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Power BI, Fabric, and enterprise AI. At Data Saturday, Power Tuning consultants lead the talks all day.
